title: Overall Satisfaction and Technology Impressions
summary: This topic mainly captures broad owner impressions of the G70, with positive comments emphasizing overall satisfaction, comfort, and technology but many fragments lacking enough context to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car as excellent or very good overall, with praise for comfort, technology, and general enjoyment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews are sparse and the examples are inconsistent, with one clearly expressing dissatisfaction while another appears misaligned with the assigned sentiment.

mixed.summary: The mixed review praises comfort and technology overall while noting a minor missing convenience feature.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments often contain incomplete ownership context or purchasing background, leaving sentiment unclear despite occasional evaluative wording.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are incomplete or context-only statements, which limits confidence in interpreting the topic beyond broad impressions.
One negative example appears sentiment-misaligned because its text is positive despite being assigned negative.
The examples include possible model-name inconsistencies such as references to other vehicles, which may reflect source noise or cross-model context.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
